# Assets · Icons

7 files under `assets/Icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for estado-ingresado.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Íconos de estado

Trazo 24px, 1.75, puntas redondeadas, `currentColor`. Uno por estado de la orden: ingresado (bandeja), en revisión (lupa), esperando repuesto (caja), en reparación (llave), reparado (check), listo para entrega (bolsa), entregado (salida). Siempre junto al nombre del estado.
